verdict.rationale: Community hands-on reports say Angular components need no bridges to use third-party JS libraries like D3, and AngularJS integrated with legacy jQuery via jQlite. Both point to direct DOM integration with visualization libraries working in practice. No first-party documentation in the pack describes the DOM-access mechanism, and the evidence is dated and thin. Missing for 10: first-party docs on direct DOM access APIs, documented guidance for integrating charting/visualization libraries, and current (modern Angular) corroboration.
